title: Where You Came From

canDo: I can say where I come from and ask somebody else, and I can start a stretch of time as well as a journey.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R46-from and run the interview's second exchange both ways -- ask kuṭhūn yetā?, answer puṇyāhūn -- then start a stretch of time with udyāpāsūn.
payoff.note: The city has been a form FIELD since chapter 23 and could not be said out loud; this chapter turns a label into an answer.
